description: Header file defining the ResourcesHLSL class, which provides methods for GLSL to HLSL translation related to uniforms and interface blocks in shader compilation.

classes.name: ResourcesHLSL
classes.description: Class for managing GLSL to HLSL translation resources, including uniforms and interface blocks.

methods.name: ResourcesHLSL
methods.description: Constructor initializing ResourcesHLSL with shader structure, output type, uniforms, and first uniform register.

methods.name: reserveUniformRegisters
methods.description: Reserves a specified number of uniform registers.

methods.name: reserveUniformBlockRegisters
methods.description: Reserves a specified number of uniform block registers.

methods.name: uniformsHeader
methods.description: Generates the header for uniforms based on referenced uniforms and symbol table.

methods.name: shaderStorageBlocksHeader
methods.description: Generates header for shader storage blocks.

methods.name: InterfaceBlockInstanceString
methods.description: Creates a string for an interface block instance with optional array index.

methods.name: getShaderStorageBlockRegisterMap
methods.description: Returns map of shader storage block register assignments.

methods.name: getUniformBlockRegisterMap
methods.description: Returns map of uniform block register assignments.

methods.name: getUniformRegisterMap
methods.description: Returns map of uniform register assignments.

methods.name: getReadonlyImage2DRegisterIndex
methods.description: Returns register index for readonly 2D images.
